will effect a 1-for-20 reverse stock split of its issued and outstanding shares of common stock, effective September 22, 2026, the company said on Friday.

The reverse split is primarily intended to increase the per share trading price of the company’s common stock to maintain compliance with the $1.00 minimum bid price requirement for continued listing on Nasdaq.
It will reduce the number of issued and outstanding shares of common stock from ~47.5M shares to ~2.4M shares.
